import json, os, time, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
config=json.loads(Path('site/practice-expansion/publication.json').read_text())
base=os.environ['PAGE_URL'].rstrip('/')+'/'
suffix='?release='+os.environ['GITHUB_SHA']
def read(path):
    req=urllib.request.Request(base+path+suffix,headers={'Cache-Control':'no-cache'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r:return r.read().decode()
for attempt in range(12):
    try:
        manifest=json.loads(read('practice-expansion/build.json'))
        assert manifest['status']=='PUBLISHED_PRACTICE' and manifest['published_question_count']==config['published_total']
        html=read('practice-expansion/')
        assert html==Path('/tmp/mpje-public-site/practice-expansion/index.html').read_text(), 'Published practice bytes differ from this build'
        assert 'id="ack"' not in html and 'MA-EXP-1024' in html and 'MA-CASE-1152' in html
        assert 'const initialQuestion=byId.get(location.hash.slice(1))||filtered[0]||(!selectedNoteId?Q[0]:null);' in html
        assert 'if(initialQuestion)openQuestion(initialQuestion);else openFilteredQuestion();' in html
        main=read('')
